We visited New Swad Restaurant for dinner and ordered Paneer Tikka Sizzler, Cold Coffee, and Chicken Thai Green Curry with Jasmine Rice.

By the time it was served, we had almost finished the Chicken Thai Green Curry with rice. Even after giving reminders, there was no improvement in timing. featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Swad Restaurant offers a great overall dining experience. There is ample parking available for 2-wheelers, and a watchman assists with parking, which is very convenient. In case you need to wait, there’s a comfortable waiting area.

The ambiance is pleasant, with plenty of tables and a small bar counter adding to the vibe.

For our meal, we ordered Chicken Manchow Soup and Chicken Triple Manchurian Rice. The taste of the food was amazing, and the presentation and cutlery in which it was served were impressive. However, the portion size felt a little small considering the price.

Our bill came to ₹715 for one Manchow Soup, one Chicken Triple Manchurian Rice, and a water bottle, which is a bit on the higher side. But considering the quality, taste, presentation, ambiance, and fast service, it felt worth it.

Overall, a great experience, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for good food in a pleasant environment.

The menu is diverse and is an eclectic mix of Indian & global fare; also of fusion i never heard of before, at least in Virar - take the chicken tikka sev puri for example, which was unusually good to taste. featured_reviews.name: vishal vashi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointing from start to finish.

First, the service was painfully slow. Our food was delivered after 40 minutes — and that’s just unacceptable, especially when you're hungry and expecting timely service.

Now coming to the charges, this is where things became ridiculous. They charged extra for the alcohol parcel service along with food, plus additional “food operation” charges. When we questioned it, the staff arrogantly stated, “No restaurant in Virar gives alcohol, but we give.” As if that justifies overcharging customers.

To make it worse, the management openly said they were instructed to charge double the amount if alcohol is delivered with food. This kind of pricing policy feels exploitative and completely unfair.

And the food quality? Pathetic. Sometimes it’s smelly, and often soggy and clearly not fresh or properly handled. Paying inflated prices for substandard food is the final insult.

Overall, extremely unprofessional management, poor service, questionable pricing practices, and low-quality food. Definitely not recommended.

It feels like a bar operating with unchecked confidence, as though they own the entire Virar West area, with little humility or regard for customers. Service, pricing transparency, and quality all need serious improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I ordered Veg Biryani from a restaurant, but the food served was extremely disappointing and did not resemble biryani at all. It tasted like plain rice mixed with half-cooked/raw vegetables. There was no biryani aroma, no proper masala, and only three very small pieces of paneer were added, which is unacceptable for the price charged for Veg Biryani.
When I called the restaurant to complain, I was told that they had less biryani masala in stock, and that is why the taste was affected. This explanation is not acceptable. If essential ingredients are not available, the item should not be prepared or sold. Charging full biryani price for such food is misleading and amounts to unfair trade practice.
Further, instead of resolving the issue properly, the restaurant disconnected my phone call when I raised the complaint. This shows irresponsible behavior and lack of customer grievance handling.
I am extremely dissatisfied with this experience and request appropriate action against the restaurant for misleading food service, poor quality, and unprofessional conduct. Kindly look into this matter and take necessary steps to protect consumers from such practices.
